title: Product Variants
description: Learn how to create product variants for size, color, and other attributes, with individual pricing and inventory.
content:
Product Variants

Product variants allow you to offer the same product in different options like size, color, material, or style, each with its own price and inventory.

Understanding Variants

Variants let customers choose:

  • Different sizes (S, M, L, XL)
  • Different colors
  • Different materials
  • Different styles
  • Combinations of attributes

Creating Variants

Step 1: Enable Variants

When creating or editing a product, enable "Has Variants" option.

Step 2: Define Attributes

Set up product attributes:

  • Size: S, M, L, XL, XXL
  • Color: Red, Blue, Green, Black
  • Material: Cotton, Polyester, Wool
  • Custom Attributes: Create your own

Step 3: Generate Variants

After defining attributes, click "Generate Variants" to create all possible combinations automatically.

Step 4: Configure Each Variant

For each variant, set:

  • SKU (unique identifier)
  • Price (can differ from base price)
  • Stock quantity
  • Images (variant-specific images)
  • Weight (for shipping calculation)

Variant Pricing

Variants can have:

  • Same price as base product
  • Different prices per variant
  • Sale prices per variant
  • Bulk pricing tiers

Variant Inventory

Track inventory separately for each variant:

  • Individual stock levels
  • Low stock alerts
  • Out of stock status
  • Automatic inventory updates

Variant Images

Assign images to specific variants:

  • Upload variant-specific images
  • Images change when variant is selected
  • Improves customer experience
  • Reduces confusion

Managing Variants

Edit variants individually or in bulk:

  • Update prices
  • Adjust inventory
  • Change SKUs
  • Enable/disable variants
  • Delete variants

Variant Display Options

Customize how variants appear:

  • Dropdown selectors
  • Color swatches
  • Image swatches
  • Buttons
  • Size charts

Best Practices

  • Use clear, consistent attribute names
  • Upload variant-specific images
  • Set appropriate prices for each variant
  • Keep SKUs unique and meaningful
  • Monitor variant inventory levels
  • Use size charts for clothing items

Limitations

Consider these limitations:

  • Maximum variants per product: 100
  • Maximum attributes: 5
  • Complex combinations may slow page load
